title: Monotonicity of bounded halting
statement: Let $P$ be a program, with input bit list $x$ and coin list $\rho$. If it halts within time bound $t$ and space bound $f$ with result $v$ and emitted bit list $o$, then for any bounds $t'\ge t$ and $f'\ge f$, it halts with the same result and emitted list within time bound $t'$ and space bound $f'$.
hypotheses_covered: The program halts within bounds $t$ and $f$ with result $v$ and output $o$
